editorial:
You know that feeling when a cute little gift ends up causing way more trouble than it should? That is exactly the vibe of Tresor. The story follows Nathalie and Jean-Pierre, a couple celebrating five years together. Jean-Pierre surprises her with an adorable four-month-old English bulldog puppy, and she instantly falls in love, naming him Tresor. The bond between Nathalie and the dog is sweet and immediate, but it slowly starts to push a wedge between the two of them. If you have ever had a pet take over your life or your relationship, you will laugh and cringe at the same time.

The movie keeps things light and funny while still showing how small problems can grow into big ones. The acting feels natural, and the dog steals nearly every scene he is in. The pacing is steady, with plenty of laughs and a few tender moments mixed in. It is not a perfect film, and some jokes land better than others, but it is a charming watch. If you enjoy feel-good comedies about love, pets, and everyday chaos, this one is worth your time. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the tension between Nathalie and Jean-Pierre reaches a breaking point as the dog keeps pulling them apart. After some honest conversations and a few funny mishaps, the couple realizes that their love for each other matters more than the jealousy and frustration the puppy caused. They find a way to share responsibility for Tresor and rebuild their bond. The movie ends on a warm, hopeful note, showing that even the messiest situations can bring people closer together.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves pet comedies and relationship humor.
